messages:
Amina (AE): FYI customer POC (APAC) is failing during load testing. They see model selection errors + lots of 429s. Need help triaging — can we swarm?
Diego (Solutions Eng): Can you paste the exact error text / sample request? 429 could be rate limits or a routing fallback to a regionless model.
Amina (AE): Here are two samples from their logs (sanitized):
```
2026-02-25T08:12:03Z ERROR request_id=xy123 model_error=MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_REGION region=ap-southeast-1
2026-02-25T08:12:04Z WARN request_id=xy124 http_status=429 error=RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED scope=customer-io
```
Amina (AE): Their POC is sending: `POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` body `{ "model": "redwood-gpt-4o", "input": "..." }`
Priya (Backend Eng): Two quick possibilities: 1) model variant `redwood-gpt-4o` isn't provisioned in APAC for hosted tier (MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_REGION) — routing should fallback but if the fallback is rate-limited you'll see 429s; 2) they're hitting per-customer concurrency quota.
Jacob (Sales Eng): They asked about sticking to a specific pinned model for evaluation — can we support pinning to a compatible variant that exists in APAC? Also they want a rough dedicated capacity price if we recommend reserved for the POC.
Diego (Solutions Eng): For pinning you can set `model_version` or a pinned alias in the request. Example temporary workaround: pin to `redwood-rl-13b-apac-v1` which is available in ap-southeast-1. If they need GPT-4 level quality we can route to eu-west with cross-region egress (customer must accept egress).
Priya (Backend Eng): Command to set model version at request-time (curl example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "redwood-rl-13b-apac-v1", "input": "Hello"}'
```
Priya (Backend Eng): If they insist on `redwood-gpt-4o`, we need to either: provision a regional instance (enterprise/Dedicated) or route to eu-west and increase their concurrency quota. I can lift their soft quota for testing if you confirm customer id.
Amina (AE): Customer id: cust-7421. They prefer not to route outside APAC due to data residency concerns — security questionnaire flagged that.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Understood. Two practical options: 1) Recommend a short Dedicated trial pool for APAC for the POC (gives guaranteed capacity and regional availability). I can spin a small reserved pool if Sales confirms commitment. 2) Use the smaller APAC-available variant and run evals to show parity for their use-case.
Jacob (Sales Eng): Quick pricing note: for a 2-week POC Dedicated trial (small pool equivalent to 1x A100 class), we usually do a time-limited credit + a discounted short-term rate. I'll coordinate SOW language.
Priya (Backend Eng): For the 429s: please capture a full request/response with headers (x-request-id, x-rate-limit-remaining). Also share the concurrency pattern (bursty vs steady). If it's bursty we can suggest client-side backoff + exponential retry.
Amina (AE): I asked the customer to share a HAR / sample request headers. They also sent the security questionnaire — they want KMS-integration + no egress for logs.
Diego (Solutions Eng): KMS + no egress => Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC egress controls. That's an enterprise blocker if they want to keep everything in APAC and locked down. I'll draft a short tech note comparing the options.
ops-bot: Deploy notice: Dedicated pool ap-southeast-1 reserved-instance created (id: dp-88d3) by Diego — scheduled completion 2026-02-25T09:30:00Z
Amina (AE): Amazing, thanks Diego. Priya — can you temporarily raise their soft concurrency limit to 50 and watch for >429s? I'll confirm with the customer about the Dedicated trial and the KMS requirement.
Priya (Backend Eng): Done — soft limit raised for cust-7421 to 50. I'll monitor for the next 4 hours and post logs.
Amina (AE): I'll run a 30-min follow-up call at 09:00 PT to finalize which route they pick. Tagging @Jacob to prep draft pricing and SOW bullets. :thumbsup:
